descriptions.en:
**Bold** marks key words and Exotic marks Exotic names.
**A bold line is bold from start to end.**
30% [15%] pairs a PvE value with its PvP value.
Lasts 11 [7.5] seconds: the bracketed value applies in PvP.
10|20|30 lists one value per stack.
30%→33% marks a value that changes.
Enhanced perks get this line; base perks get their own.
Variables and math arrive worked out: 3 stacks, 30%, 3x.
Notes carry extra text for a word.
[Links](https://d2clarity.com) open a web page.

• Bullets start list lines.
• The gap above this list is a spacer line.
Kinetic Arc Solar Void Stasis Strand Prismatic
Primary Special Heavy
Barrier Overload Unstoppable
Hunter Titan Warlock
Element words come with their element, to draw as its icon or tint: Kinetic, Jolt, Scorch, Volatile, Slow, Sever, Transcendence.
[enh]15% is an enhanced value: only Enhanced perks have this line.
